name: Galapa
description: Turtle-like humanoids with retractable shells for protection, Galapa names are unhurried and calm, like the folk who carry them.

features.name: Shell
features.description: Gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your Proficiency.

features.name: Retract
features.description: Mark a Stress to retract into your shell. While in your shell, you have resistance to physical damage, you have disadvantage on action rolls, and you can't move.
